nodes.summary: An $n \times n$ Boolean matrix $M$, with rows and columns indexed by $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$, is an upper-triangular $(0, 1)$-poset matrix when its entries strictly below the main diagonal are false ($M_{ij}$ is false whenever $j < i$), its diagonal entries $M_{ii}$ are true, and its true entries are transitive: if $M_{ij}$ and $M_{jk}$ are true, then $M_{ik}$ is true.

inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.
